text: すき　こそ　ものの　じょうず　なれ…　だな！
note: He is quoting a set Japanese proverb, 好きこそ物の上手なれ: you become skilled at the things you love.
claim: 好きこそ物の上手なれ is a Japanese proverb meaning that one becomes good at what one likes.

check.quote: 好きな事にはおのずと熱中できるから、上達が早いものだ。
check.note: He is quoting a set Japanese proverb, 好きこそ物の上手なれ: you become skilled at the things you love.
